nodes.title: open｜開放
body: 服務接受相應通訊
接著查用途、版本與保護設定

nodes.title: closed｜關閉
body: 明確回覆，工具判為無服務接聽
接著查程式啟動與綁定位置

nodes.title: filtered｜受到過濾
body: 探測呈現過濾情況
接著查路徑、規則與日誌

nodes.title: 共同條件｜保留觀察視角
body: 來源位置＋方法＋時間
同一入口可有不同存取條件

footer: 狀態配上證據，下一步就清楚。
/images/ceh/m03-04-01-core-states-zh-TW..title: 三個核心狀態：各有下一步
/images/ceh/m03-04-01-core-states-zh-TW..description: 三種分類與觀察條件並列，沒有流程箭頭。

nodes.title: open
body: A service accepts corresponding communication
Check purpose, version, and protection

nodes.title: closed
body: A definite response indicates no listener
Check the running program and binding

nodes.title: filtered
body: Probe results indicate filtering
Check path, rules, and logs

nodes.title: Shared context: observation perspective
body: Source location + method + time
One entry point can have different access conditions

footer: Pair each state with evidence and a next step.
/images/ceh/m03-04-01-core-states-en.svg.title: Three core states: different next steps
/images/ceh/m03-04-01-core-states-en.svg.description: Parallel categories and observation conditions, with no flow arrows.

nodes.title: 收到 SYN／ACK → open
body: 對方回應連線請求
查核服務與允許來源

nodes.title: 收到 RST → closed
body: 觀察欄記下重設回應
到設備端核對接聽設定

nodes.title: 重試無回應／特定 ICMP → filtered
body: 保留等待與重試條件
查核政策與路徑紀錄

nodes.title: 每筆都記｜方法與回應
body: 方法：TCP SYN 掃描
觀察、工具分類、設備證據分開

footer: 這是同一方法下的結果比較。
/images/ceh/m03-04-02-syn-responses-zh-T.title: TCP SYN：回應與分類對照
/images/ceh/m03-04-02-syn-responses-zh-T.description: SYN掃描三種常見回應與紀錄方式的並列比較。

nodes.title: SYN/ACK received → open
body: The peer responds to the connection request
Check the service and allowed sources

nodes.title: RST received → closed
body: Record the reset as an observation
Check listening settings on the device

nodes.title: Silence / certain ICMP errors → filtered
body: Preserve waiting and retry conditions
Check policy and path records

nodes.title: For each result: method and response
body: Method: TCP SYN scan
Separate observation, classification, and evidence

footer: These are alternative results under one method.
/images/ceh/m03-04-02-syn-responses-en.s.title: TCP SYN: responses and states
/images/ceh/m03-04-02-syn-responses-en.s.description: Parallel comparison of three common SYN-scan responses and recording practice.

nodes.title: 相應 UDP 回覆 → open
body: 有可核對的回覆內容
查核服務設定

nodes.title: IPv4 ICMP Type 3／Code 3 → closed
body: 連接埠無法到達
查核該入口的接聽程式

nodes.title: 其他符合條件的 ICMP → filtered
body: 依訊息判讀過濾情況
查核路徑與政策

nodes.title: 重試後無回應 → open|filtered
body: 開放或過濾，保留兩個方向
比對服務格式、服務與防火牆日誌

footer: 先看方法，再看回應，最後讀狀態。
/images/ceh/m03-04-03-udp-responses-zh-T.title: UDP：四種觀察、四個查核方向
/images/ceh/m03-04-03-udp-responses-zh-T.description: UDP回應與四個候選分類並列，沉默保留兩種可能。

nodes.title: Corresponding UDP reply → open
body: Response content is available to check
Verify service settings

nodes.title: IPv4 ICMP Type 3 / Code 3 → closed
body: Port unreachable
Check the program listening at the entry point

nodes.title: Other qualifying ICMP errors → filtered
body: Interpret filtering from the message
Check the path and policy

nodes.title: No response after retries → open|filtered
body: Keep both open and filtered as candidates
Compare format, service logs, and firewall logs

footer: Read method, then response, then state.
/images/ceh/m03-04-03-udp-responses-en.s.title: UDP: four observations and next steps
/images/ceh/m03-04-03-udp-responses-en.s.description: Parallel UDP-response categories; silence preserves two possibilities.

nodes.title: 1｜記錄測試條件
body: 目標、授權範圍、來源網段
時間時區、方法、版本與設定

nodes.title: 2｜分開觀察與判讀
body: 保存回應與原始輸出
記錄工具狀態與 --reason 理由

nodes.title: 3｜交叉核對設計
body: 服務接聽設定與應用程式日誌
防火牆規則與同時段紀錄

nodes.title: 4｜安排下一步
body: 預期與實際差異、負責人
依核准範圍安排重測

footer: 每一步都留下可追溯的證據。
/images/ceh/m03-04-04-evidence-record-zh.title: 把結果整理成可重現的紀錄
/images/ceh/m03-04-04-evidence-record-zh.description: 從測試條件到觀察判讀、交叉查核與核准下一步。

nodes.title: 1 | Record test conditions
body: Target, authorized scope, and source subnet
Time zone, method, version, and settings

nodes.title: 2 | Separate observation and interpretation
body: Preserve responses and original output
Record tool state and the --reason explanation

nodes.title: 3 | Cross-check the design
body: Listening settings and application logs
Firewall rules and records from the same period

nodes.title: 4 | Plan the next step
body: Expected versus observed results and owner
Arrange a retest within the approved scope

footer: Keep traceable evidence at each step.
/images/ceh/m03-04-04-evidence-record-en.title: Build a reproducible verification record
/images/ceh/m03-04-04-evidence-record-en.description: Move from test conditions to observation, cross-checking, and an approved next step.
